jobs.name: 01-dwarf-cleric
jobs.subject: A short, stocky, broad-shouldered dwarf woman cleric in battered plate armour, braided hair, raising a glowing holy symbol in a dark dungeon corridor, skeletons lurching out of the shadows towards her, torchlight on wet stone

jobs.name: 02-elf-wizard
jobs.subject: A young elf wizard with long silver hair studying a floating spellbook in a cluttered tower library, candlelight and drifting motes of arcane light

jobs.name: 03-halfling-rogue
jobs.subject: A grinning halfling rogue in a dark hooded cloak crouched on a tavern rafter above a crowded common room, a stolen coin purse in one hand

jobs.name: 04-ruined-keep
jobs.subject: A ruined hilltop keep at dusk seen from the road below, crows circling the broken tower, a small party of adventurers climbing the path

jobs.name: 05-red-dragon
jobs.subject: A red dragon perched on a crumbling mountain ridge, wings half spread, smoke curling from its jaws, a tiny knight on horseback on the path far below for scale

jobs.name: 06-owlbear-ambush
jobs.subject: An owlbear bursting out of a misty pine forest onto a muddy trail, a ranger drawing her bow and a fighter raising his shield

jobs.name: 07-lich
jobs.subject: A lich in tattered royal robes on a throne of bone in a vast crypt, green witchlight burning in its eye sockets, its phylactery glowing on the armrest

jobs.name: 08-market-city
jobs.subject: A bustling harbour city market at midday, merchants of many peoples under colourful awnings, tall ships in the harbour behind, gulls overhead

jobs.name: 09-sword-spot
jobs.subject: An ornate longsword with a sapphire pommel lying on a velvet cloth, on a plain parchment background, spot illustration

jobs.name: 10-potion-spot
jobs.subject: Three glass potion bottles of different shapes, one glowing red, one swirling blue, one smoking green, on a plain parchment background, spot illustration

jobs.name: 11-tiefling-warlock
jobs.subject: A tiefling warlock with curling horns and a long coat conjuring violet eldritch fire between her hands on a rain-soaked city rooftop at night

jobs.name: 12-sahuagin-raid
jobs.subject: Sahuagin warriors with tridents climbing out of the surf onto a moonlit fishing village beach, villagers fleeing with lanterns
